paragraphs: In Vayikra Rabbah 25:6, Nagda said, “It is written: ‘An eight-day-old [child].’” Rabbi Tanchuma said Nagda's view was reasonable, etc. This entire statement is absent from Bereshit Rabbah 40:5; see there.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The absence of the statement from the Bereshit Rabbah parallel is Hyman’s observation, not a new search of all editions.

The consulted Vayikra Rabbah 25:6 contains Nagda’s eight-day argument and Rabbi Tanchuma’s response. The returned Bereshit Rabbah 40:5 paragraph concerns Sarah’s arrival in Egypt. Hyman’s claim that the Nagda passage is missing from that parallel remains his observation of the cited text, not a census of all editions.
